name: viiversion-demo-studio
description: Create polished presentation videos from web applications.

interface.shortDescription: Turn web apps into demo videos
interface.longDescription: Inspect a public web application, plan a concise walkthrough, record browser interactions, and render a polished MP4 presentation with motion, captions, branding, and multiple aspect ratios. The plugin defaults to non-destructive demonstrations and should only interact with applications the user is authorized to access.
